comment: audit-bundle.mjs's allowlist (20261005-portable-app-download): `files` are the patterns every file of the packaged .app must match (the file list), `allow` the build-shaped paths that may appear, each with its reason. This machine's own paths (home, checkout, ~/.bun, ~/.t3, the temporary folder, every --forbid) are never allowed.

allow.reason: Not a path: the template literal `/Users/${user}` of terminal-links.ts (a terminal link's home-folder form), which the Hermes string table stores beside the next literal, /api/auth/session.

package-app.mjs's fixed export folder, the same on every machine (no user, checkout or home path): exact2's ibex2 build.rs and js/build.rs give hermesc absolute source paths, and Hermes keeps them as the bytecode's file names (EXACT2-GAPS X50). Rust paths are remapped and Swift's are stripped; these two cannot be from the app.
